original.discovery_notes: A straight-line integer routine called three times by 0x8802d5e0. Nearby code folds bytes into the same value, so checksum_mix_step is a provisional semantic name.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_8802d5b0.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 3 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Seven controlled inputs were executed by the original R4600 instructions in MAME and then by the native C reconstruction. All 64-bit results match exactly. The fixtures include bit 32 because the original three-call wrapper forwards the full intermediate result.
